_comment: Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.claude\speak-config.json. Read by speak-engine.ps1 only — speak-onecore.ps1 ignores it. Run scripts/speak-voices.ps1 to see what this machine actually has.
_engine: jaws | nvda | onecore | sapi | auto  (auto = a running screen reader, else onecore)
_voice: Substring of the voice id or display name, from speak-voices.ps1's 'match' field. Ignored for jaws and nvda.
_rate: onecore: 0.5 to 6.0 (6 fastest). sapi: -10 to 10. null = fastest. IGNORED for jaws and nvda, deliberately — rate there is the user's own setting.
_interrupt: Whether a new reply cuts off the previous one still speaking.
_nvdaClientDll: Full path to nvdaControllerClient64.dll. Leave empty to auto-search %USERPROFILE%\.claude and the NVDA install. The DLL does NOT ship with NVDA — get it from NV Access's controller client package.
